final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost / NULLIF(rental_rate, 0)) AS rating_average FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(rating_average) AS overall_average FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.rating_average) AS average_rating_average, AVG(r.rating_average - o.overall_average) AS average_difference FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND r.rating_average > o.overall_average
